facts.fact: Revises F297: after Muthu came out of the guardroom with the grey-sealed packet, Devan took it from his hand openly, in front of Bhaskaran and the yard, to lock it in the hall strongbox with the rest of the post for the spring rider. Muthu shrugged it off as routine. The wax stayed unbroken and Muthu believes his letters are unread. Ittan at the grille said only 'You've no idea whose hand I am, my friend' and then fell silent, the price of Neela's choice to wait an hour (ch 31).

Revises F299: seven weeks before the wedding Devan wrote to the council that the raiders' tallies carried true wax and asked to see every seal register. He realises now that those registers lead to Ittan's box, and the queen sealed the payment writ as he closed on Ittan.
